note: Adjudication of every H3.1-vs-H3.2 divergence class on the first official run. Disagreement rows freeze only through a row here (T3.1 doctrine). Register ids referenced here are minted in the planning estate (41-FINDINGS / 20-CANDIDATES), not in this repo.

rows.rationale: '(a+)+b' is the canonical ReDoS shape; rejection (empty stream) is the ratified sentinel/precheck design working as intended. The oracle's pure-regex matches ('ab' substrings inside ordinary words) are unreachable by design. No finding.

Dense-hit cells (>100 matches on one page) nondeterministically lose early-yielded hits: the search stream's AsyncStream bufferingNewest(100) policy evicts the oldest buffered results when the consumer lags a burst (measured host: scan-sim run-1 v01 dropped 11 of 141 page-5 hits while run-2 and the vector twin kept all; final-cache re-derivation confirms 141 is the true count). Freeze takes the higher-yield run per cell (drops only lose hits); the drop mechanism is F12-08. Applies mechanically to any burst cell the freeze phase reconciles, not only r06.

observations.note: q24 (U+2011 non-breaking-hyphen query) matches ONLY when normalizeUnicode is OFF and normalizeSmartPunctuation is ON: NFKC maps U+2011 to U+2010 HYPHEN, which the smart-punctuation fold map does not contain, so the default-options pipeline never folds it to ASCII '-'. Product and oracle agree (both implement the documented order); surfaced by bank design, not by the diff. Candidate C12-81 (add U+2010 to the map / fold before NFKC).

multiTerm with an empty term in the list: OR mode ignores the empty term; AND mode returns nothing on every page (the empty term never attributes a hit, so no page satisfies the conjunction). Live preview additionally FILTERS empty terms and never applies the AND page filter at all, so preview counts and full-search results diverge on AND-mode and degenerate inputs. Candidate C12-82.

retired_rows.rationale: The product safety gate rejects '4111(\s?\d{4}){3}' (hasNestedQuantifiers counts the bounded {3} and ? as nested quantifiers) and yields an empty stream; the oracle finds the card value twice on page 1. GT freezes the product contract (0 hits) so the baseline measures shipped behavior against its own contract; the over-conservative static gate itself is the F12-07 finding (with the H3.4 benign-rejection rate as the corpus-level measurement) and any future gate relaxation rebaselines these cells via the log.

retired.reason: The regex safety gate no longer refuses '4111(\s?\d{4}){3}': a group closed by a bounded quantifier is not treated as nesting (the iOS PR's first commit), so the product returns the oracle's count and the safety-rejection contract these cells froze is retired; the cells re-freeze from the post-gate run (REBASELINE-LOG row 6). F12-07 is FIXED by the same change; the H3.4 benign-rejection rate is the corpus-level measurement.
